description: MCP server for TheBrain 15: search by meaning, graph traversal and batch writes over the local API
name: io.github.yBookoff/thebrain

environmentVariables.description: Local API key from TheBrain: Settings > User > Local API Key
environmentVariables.name: THEBRAIN_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Address of the local API. Default http://localhost:8001
environmentVariables.name: THEBRAIN_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Where semantic indexes are stored. Default ~/.thebrain-mcp
environmentVariables.name: THEBRAIN_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow deleting thoughts. Deletion still requires human confirmation. Default 0
environmentVariables.name: THEBRAIN_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE

environmentVariables.description: Embedding model for semantic search. Default Xenova/multilingual-e5-small
environmentVariables.name: THEBRAIN_EMBEDDING_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Weight precision: fp32, fp16, q8 or q4. Default q8
environmentVariables.name: THEBRAIN_EMBEDDING_DTYPE

environmentVariables.description: API request timeout in milliseconds. Default 30000
environmentVariables.name: THEBRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS
